games.imagesHtml: 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗
games.shortDescription: A fresh 360° spot-the-difference game for solo or co-op
games.longDescription:
Arcadia: Find the Difference 3D is a 3D spot-the-difference game that invites you to slow down, explore, and enjoy beautifully crafted, fully rotatable scenes. Each level presents a detailed 360° 3D environment where you search for five hidden differences. Some are easy to notice, while others reward patience, curiosity, and careful observation.

The game also includes special levels where players solve mystery puzzles or complete mini-games, adding variety beyond the classic spot-the-difference experience.

Arcadia is designed to be relaxing rather than stressful. There are no timers pushing you forward and no punishment for failing a level. Instead, the game encourages you to take your time, rotate each scene, and enjoy the details from every angle.

Key Features
Artistic and Visual Experience

Every part of Arcadia is created with a strong focus on art and atmosphere. From handcrafted 3D models and detailed environments to a clean user interface and calm background music, the game aims to create a visually pleasing and comfortable space for players to explore.

Explore in Full 360 Degrees

Freely rotate each scene and examine it from any direction. Some differences can only be discovered by changing your viewpoint, making exploration an important part of the experience.

Local Co-op and Online Play

Arcadia supports both local co-op and online multiplayer. Normal levels can be played in local co-op by enabling the option in the settings, making it easy to enjoy the game together on the same device.

The game also includes a real-time online mode where up to 15 players can compete together, adding a fun and social way to experience the world of Arcadia.

Varied and Interactive Gameplay

In addition to classic spot-the-difference challenges, Arcadia includes more than ten mini-games. Some differences also involve simple puzzle interactions, adding variety and a sense of discovery to each level.

Expansive Worlds to Discover

Arcadia currently features over 50 uniquely themed scenes, each with its own mood and visual style. More scenes and mini-games are planned for future updates, expanding the world over time.

Progression and Collectibles

By completing levels, players earn stars that can be used in an in-game building system. These stars allow you to unlock and place beautiful furniture to decorate your room.

Hidden Easter eggs throughout the game can also unlock exclusive 3D figurines, encouraging players to explore carefully and enjoy the experience beyond simply finding differences.

Accessibility and Inclusive Design

Arcadia is designed so visual differences are never based on color alone. Differences can be identified through shape, lighting, texture, or placement. A colorblind-friendly mode improves contrast and visual clarity, helping make the game more comfortable for players with color vision differences.
